findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: canvas_validate_canvas, export_diagram · Private data: canvas_add_lineage, create_diagram, export_diagram · Public sink: canvas_set_columns, canvas_group_nodes, canvas_add_flow_arrow, export_diagram · Destructive: canvas_remove_nodes, canvas_disconnect_nodes, canvas_set_columns, canvas_remove_lineage, canvas_move_nodes, canvas_view, canvas_batch, get_diagram.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: canvas_validate_canvas, export_diagram · Private data: canvas_add_lineage, create_diagram, export_diagram · Public sink: canvas_set_columns, canvas_group_nodes, canvas_add_flow_arrow, export_diagram · Destructive: canvas_remove_nodes, canvas_disconnect_nodes, canvas_set_columns, canvas_remove_lineage, canvas_move_nodes, canvas_view, canvas_batch, get_diagram

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
